card.title: For the Record
card.instruction: Get someone to state exactly what they did, knew, or authorized before you reveal your own involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I show you my dinner invitations, who did you authorize your sister to bring?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A date. Did you invite my ex?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did you name anyone she couldn't bring? Then we'll get to my list.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. My ex. I sent you both the same message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What time did you send it to me? I'll put that beside my invitation's timestamp before we open it.

mechanism: A pins down B's guest authorization and notice timing before opening A's own invitation record.
confusable: Unlike ordinary party planning, A delays implicated disclosure until B commits to exact prior knowledge and instructions.
comparison: Timestamp comparison follows an explicit exclusion, unlike the fireworks example's trailer-size authorization.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
